resources.method: Visible Linux procfs RSS sampled over parent/known workers/available descendants; null means unavailable. Per-worker ru_maxrss reports own peak and largest reaped child peak separately. Summed RSS double-counts shared pages, is not unique physical RAM, and can omit inaccessible descendants.
